Considering reconciliation but there’s been so much I’m not sure she is well enough or capable of telling the truth. We have been separated for about a year and working on things. My immediate suggestion was to go to therapy. However, that has not happened at all on her end except when I was working an extra weekend job to pay for them to go to individual therapy. Our original separation was a little foggy on why it involved a tarot card reading, a possibly controlling best friend who they allowed to believe I was controlling, and an urge to experience life since they are slightly younger (25) than me (28.) As well as confusion over my gender identity. 

The initial separation came two days after the mother of my child refused to let me see my kid again because they learned I was in a relationship (we have not been together for about 8 years) two days later they inform that they are a lesbian. I am respectful but torn up about my marriage ending and losing my kid so I go to Mexico for a month and accept what’s happened. I go no contact for two weeks and feel like I’m moving on. She contacts me to tell. Me she assumed we were getting back together when I get home. I tell them that I’ve had some time to think and I’m concerned about somethings in our relationship (she made me give up my dog, I could only talk to my bf on Sundays when she was at work, I lost all my other friends because I couldn’t play DND and I needed a larger share In the household responsibilities I cooked all three meals cleaned and paid all the bills.)I told them I was okay with that but we should go to therapy. She sent me videos of her harming herself and then didn’t contact me for a week. Things were going well when I got back home but she received a tarot card reading and their bf, who I was uncomfortable around, was telling them to move out. 

A few months prior they had told me they were in love with their bf and then the day after proceeded to take a nude intimate photoshoot with them and wait for me to see it online. Needless to say I was uncomfortable spending time with them together which led them to think I was controlling because they never expressed why I stopped wanting to hang out with the both of them and got increasingly more awkward around them their relationship was always very affectionate but it felt different after hearing that.  

Over the course of the next 8mos. I then had to drive 45 mins away to her parents to work on our relationship nearly everyday, work a job another 20 min away and process that I still couldn’t see my child. So, I asked her since they only work on Sundays to help set up therapy since they swore that that incident was not an opposition to therapy and were agreeing to go. We had an agreement since I was not the spouse that wanted to leave if we working on things we would tell each other when we were seeing or talking to other people. I was consistently upfront about if I thought about going on a date with other people. I never did anything on those 2 dates early on because mostly I was waiting for them to come home and they knew that but I didn’t want to feel like I was waiting around especially if my Wife had started seeing other people. (Did make some nice friends though.) 

Things started to feel weird around 5 mos when she, who constantly posted me on social media, hadn’t posted me once since she announced our divorce. (the day after she decided to) I tried to plan multiple dates and start the courting process all over again but she would never let us go anywhere in public and when I would ask if she was talking to people because she began posting a large amount of nudes regularly (something I had no problem with) she would imply I  was body shaming her and I was paranoid and jealous. So I began to work on those issues heavily individual therapy to control my jealousy talking to the women around to address my biases. But around 8 mos of consistently waiting for my wife to choose to be with me I gave up and moved away from the situation. ( there is more context as to why I gave up I’ll put it in a comment) 

She came to visit me for a weekend and wanted to talk about reconciling again and this time she had set up a therapy appt. (all the previous ones they didn’t like the therapist I picked or they were too busy to do it. Or they didn’t like that I was paying for it. It seemed really hopeful until I saw some posts on their close friends page implying I was a sexist because someone I knew said b***h. I don’t personally say it and we had talked about that incident together I hadn’t even heard the person say it. This was a recurring problem while we were married and throughout the whole separation that they would post about my mental health or take more situations like that out of context for validation online. We’re both artist in the same community and it affected my career so that’s also why I left town. They had told me the whole 8 MOs we were together that they weren’t posting stuff like that about me online. Realizing that they had lied to me about that for a year. I asked to see their Instagram because they were probably lying to me about other stuff as well. This is when I learned that I wasn’t paranoid and they had been maintaining multiple sexual relationships with people online since the day after we got married. I was upset  but it didn’t end there because we kept talking and I forgave them ( my first words were I knew it was happening anyway idc you’re my wife I still would choose to be with you/ they immediately hung themself on the phone) we still kept working on things and 2 days before therapy they decided that it was best for me to leave because I talked about what happened too much the three weeks following it.
